raw_token: # Maps every distinct token in the source's `Disposition` column to outcome flags.
# periods. An unmapped token FAILS the build.
# Disposition is modelled as a SET of flags rather than one class
# routinely carry several outcomes at once ("Closed; Subject arrested; Trespass notice
# issued"). Forcing a single label would throw real outcomes away.
#   outcome       an outcome; contributes its flags
#   audit_marker  the university noting that it revised this row. Flags from tokens
#                 BEFORE the marker are superseded. "Open/Active; Disposition updated;
#                 Closed" means the case is CLOSED
